purpose: Test fixtures for the on-device calendar scanner (PRO-335). Each entry mirrors the cross-platform calendar event format the app receives after the user grants Calendar permission (EKEvent on iOS / CalendarContract.Events on Android). Ground truth (is_medical, expected_keywords, variation tags) lives in _test_metadata — strip this block before processing in production.
schema_note: EventKit-aligned fields: eventIdentifier (iOS) / _id (Android), title, location, notes (= description on Android), startDate (= dtstart), endDate (= dtend), isAllDay (= allDay), calendar.{title, source} (= provenance), hasRecurrenceRules (= rrule presence; full RRULE strings not modelled here), url. Times are wall-clock with timezone offset (Europe/Amsterdam for nl-NL, Europe/London for en-GB). _test_metadata is fictional and prefixed with underscore to flag as non-system data.
